                  branch={activeBranch} 
                  allUsers={allUsers} 
                  onRefresh={fetchUsers} 
                  onBranchUpdated={(b) => {
                    setActiveBranch(b);
                    fetchBranches(); // Fetch from backend to ensure the whole list is up to date
                  }}
                  onBack={() => handleClearBranch()} 
                  innerTab={activeTab === 'staff' ? 'users' : 'config'} 
                />
